note: Compiled 26 Nov 2026 from github.com/trending (fetched live) and community signals from Hacker News via last30days (Reddit, GitHub and Polymarket data were not available today). No separate web search was used; videos are carried over from the previous feed because no new YouTube ids could be verified today.

news.title: LLM agents work for their parent companies, not for you
news.summary: An essay arguing agents should owe duties to their users, prompted by an agent honouring a site's no-LLM wishes. Hacker News: 1013 points, 410 comments; commenters call the argument flimsy.

news.title: Oops I Parsed It Again: Tool-Call Smuggling Against LLM Agents
news.summary: A new paper on attacks that smuggle tool calls past agent parsers (25 Nov). Only 3 points on Hacker News, so treat as early; relevant to anyone writing tool-calling loops.

news.title: Songe: a training engine for your local model, using your idle compute
news.summary: An open-source engine for training a local model on idle compute (24 Nov). Hacker News: 234 points, 74 comments.

news.title: Faster Retrieval for Better, More Efficient RAG
news.summary: Apple research on making the retrieval step of RAG cheaper. Hacker News: 243 points, 40 comments; commenters debate embeddings versus grep.

news.title: Vibecoding an inference chip
news.summary: A blog post on designing an inference accelerator with AI coding help (20 Nov). Hacker News: 180 points, 80 comments.

news.title: Cerebras launches disaggregated inference
news.summary: Cerebras announces serving that splits inference stages across separate hardware (18 Nov). Hacker News: 109 points, 27 comments.

news.title: Announcing the XLA Serving Engine
news.summary: Google open-sources a serving engine for XLA-based inference (6 Nov). Only 3 points on Hacker News so far, so treat as early.

news.title: End-to-End 4-Bit Training
news.summary: Thinking Machines describes training models with 4-bit precision throughout (13 Nov). Hacker News: 24 points.

news.title: Pete Warden on local AI, open models, voice interfaces, the future of hardware
news.summary: A podcast conversation on running models locally and where hardware is heading (19 Nov). Hacker News: 274 points, 254 comments.

news.title: Apple has new Mac app coming to make running local AI models easy
news.summary: Reported: 9to5Mac says Apple is working on a Mac app for running local models. Hacker News: 580 points, 572 comments.

news.title: Chinese frontier AI models carry the fingerprint of export-controlled GPUs
news.summary: A contested analysis claiming model checkpoints reveal training on restricted GPUs. Hacker News: 458 points, 199 comments; commenters question the author's code-less evidence.

tools.title: Songe
tools.summary: Training engine for a local model that uses idle compute; worth reading for small-model training ideas. Hacker News: 234 points.

tools.title: Langfuse AI Gateway
tools.summary: Open-source Rust gateway that traces every LLM call; useful for watching agent token use. Hacker News: 9 points.

tools.title: Weir
tools.summary: Catches credential leaks in the AI agents you build and use. Hacker News: 5 points, so early.

tools.title: minimind
tools.summary: Trains a 64M-parameter LLM from scratch in about two hours; a good companion to from-scratch study.

tools.title: firecrawl
tools.summary: Search, scrape and data access API for AI agents, handy for RAG ingestion.

tools.summary: Toolkit for optimizing and deploying AI inference.
